title: Chromosome 15 — 15q11-q13 interval
clinical_history: Schematic map of one chromosome 15. The 15q11-q13 interval is drawn large enough to name and remove. It is a small fraction of the long arm, not a large G-band loss. A routine karyotype of this deletion is usually normal. This map does not show which parent contributed the chromosome.

assembly.schematic_note: Schematic chromosome 15. The 15q11-q13 interval is enlarged only enough to identify and delete. Routine G-banding usually does not show this microdeletion as a short chromosome. The conventional teaching karyotype remains 46,XX.
